name: talk-to-anyone

owner.name: Colton Dean (original) — fork maintained by phidiastheodosiou-glitch

description: Marketplace for the Talk to Anyone coach plugin

plugins.name: talk-to-anyone
plugins.description: Turn anyone into your personal coach — a public figure living or historical, or a fictional character from a book, film, series or game. /coach <name> researches them across the web, pulls real transcripts from YouTube, their books (public domain, author-released, or your own copies), and their podcast feed — including audiobooks serialized as episodes — then talks to you as them. Fork of coltonjosephdean-rgb/talk-to-anyone.
